runs.expected: real run_report closure invokes author then reviewer; changes_requested causes a second author with findings and changed HTML hash, approved review reaches publication; reviewer transport failure still reaches publication with a truthful fallback
runs.actual: 2 failed before reviewer. Both invoke author, then NameError in `_daily_report_save_ai_wrapper` (production_workflow.py:8064, called at :9105) because `store`, `source_attempt_id`, and `job_id` are unbound. The report fallback then fails with AttributeError in `_persist_minimal_daily_report` (:8267/:8272), reason report_fallback_failed; publication spy is called but receives no completed report. Recorded causes in temp fixture `data/maintenance/failure-journal/events.jsonl` and durable JUnit/console. Exact product defect sent to FC06 owner. No reviewer/revision/publication success claimed; rerun held only until FC06 fix.

runs.expected: changes_requested triggers author revision and approved review reaches publication; reviewer transport failure keeps an unknown/unavailable review report and reaches publication
runs.actual: 1 passed, 1 failed. The changes_requested case genuinely calls author/reviewer/author/reviewer; second author receives prior findings, result_version changes, reviewed HTML SHA changes, and publication receives approved report. The transport-failure case calls author and reviewer then reaches publication callback, but callback receives report_result=None because the fallback reuses an already-written report artifact and raises `InvestigationContractError→FileExistsError`, reason `investigation_artifact_already_exists` at production_workflow.py:8393 / investigation.py:753. Exact failure sent to FC06. The transport case remains unpassed pending product fix and exact rerun.
